# Rockstar announces official GTA 6 trading card collection
Rockstar and Panini will release officially licensed GTA 6 sports trading cards in December 2026

**Rockstar Games has partnered with trading card manufacturer Panini to release an officially licensed Grand Theft Auto 6 trading card collection, bringing part of the game's fictional sports universe into the real world.**
Announced on November 24, the collaboration will introduce the GTA VI: Sports Trading Card Collection in December 2026. The release will feature cards based on fictional athletes and teams from the world of GTA 6.

> Grand Theft Auto VI official trading cards, coming soon from @PaniniAmerica and @RockstarGames. pic.twitter.com/H1VrYVXTm5
The game itself includes 480 collectible cards spread across 18 different sets. These feature fictional sports stars, comic book characters and nightclub dancers, with players able to sell rare finds at pawn shops for additional in-game money.

However, the physical Panini collection appears to focus on the sports-themed cards rather than reproducing the entire range of in-game collectibles.
According to Panini's product listing, each hobby box will contain four packs, with four cards in each pack. Collectors can expect an average of two Rookie cards, one Retro card, one Illustrated card and four Special Silvers per box.

The collection will also include limited-edition colour variants and numbered parallels. Bronze Legend cards will be restricted to 49 copies, while Silver Legends will have a print run of 25. The rarest option will be Gold cards, with only one copy of each produced.

The sports cards you dig out of drawers, locked safes and glove boxes in *Grand Theft Auto VI* are about to exist for real. Panini America and Rockstar Games have announced the *GTAVI*: Sports Trading Card Collection, the first official physical trading cards for the game, bringing real-world versions of the in-game card collectibles to shelves in December 2026. This is a true hobby product, packs and boxes and numbered chase cards and all.

The Panini set is a physical collector release built around the game's sports teams, while the in-game cards are a digital system of 480 collectibles across 18 sets that you find around Leonida and sell at pawn shops. If you want to know the card locations, pawn prices and the completion trophies, those belong with the in-game cards. The Panini product is aimed squarely at trading card hobbyists.

Panini and Rockstar made the deal official on November 24, 2026 through a press release, with product pages set to follow on the Panini America site. The official licensing partner is Rockstar's parent company, Take-Two Interactive.

The first card revealed is Dartanyon Pearson, a wide receiver for the Liberty City Wrath wearing number 84, the kind of fictional-but-convincing athlete the game's sports world runs on.

Panini is building this like one of its real sports lines. A four-pack box averages two Rookies, one Retro, one Illustrated and four Special Silvers, with the chase sitting in the parallels and the numbered cards. Color parallels run Silver, Pink, Teal and Light Blue, alongside team-color parallels tied to each squad. The serial-numbered tier climbs from Legend Bronze numbered to 49, to Silver numbered to 25, up to a one-of-one Gold.
